fields.label: Job Titles to Match
fields.description: One reference title per line. These form the built-in Job Title research heuristic; a similar title or matching job description can satisfy it. Not an exact-match filter.

fields.label: Location to Match
fields.description: Match the complete job location, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace.

fields.label: Employment Type
fields.options:
Full Time
Part Time
Contract
Temporary
Internship

fields.label: Seniority
fields.options:
Junior
Mid
Senior
Staff
Principal
Lead
Manager
Director
Executive

fields.label: Minimum Compensation
fields.description: Qualify advertised compensation when its upper bound (or single advertised amount) is at least this threshold.

fields.label: Allow Heuristic
fields.description: When compensation is not given, require a researcher assessment that expected pay is well above the search minimum.

fields.label: Active In the Past
fields.description: Positive number of days, weeks, months, or years. Measured back from today using the Job Last Active Date; leave both fields empty for no date restriction.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: Unit for the rolling Active In the Past window.

fields.label: Custom Research Heuristics
fields.description: Subjective research criteria. Each row has a name and a description; these instructions are evaluated by the researcher, not by deterministic filters.

fields.label: Require Explicit Heuristic Approval
fields.description: Only explicitly included jobs appear in this search.

fields.label: Assigned Research Strategies
fields.description: Select reusable research strategies. Lower effective priority numbers run first; an empty Priority Override uses the strategy default.
